Messages.Author: tych...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
Reading through the card text:

WMRH Talk Radio
Cost: 1 Pool
Unique Location

Tap to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action. If that
minion doesn't successfully block the action, burn 1 pool after the
action resolves.

I have the evil notion that this card could be used by a heavy stealth
deck to give intercept to a prey's minion, and then stealth past
anyway, adding the 1 pool loss to say a bleed of 3. Is this the case?

Not to say it is a major deck-building tactic, but helps you cycle
stealth and oust your prey if he/she is not wily enough.

Learn to read. *You* burn the pool, not the controller of the minion.

> Not to say it is a major deck-building tactic, but helps you cycle
> stealth and oust your prey if he/she is not wily enough.

You could do this with London Evening Star if you really wanted to, but
WMRH and KRCG are going to make you lose pool, which is stupid...

No. The added one pool loss is a loss of your own pool (you, the
controller of WMRH), not of the would-be blocker's controller's
pool.
